guides.title: Ideas for your next trip
guides.body: Guides written for groups of friends: add the destinations you like to your trip and put them to the vote.

landing.subtitle: Collect the places you dream about, vote on them with friends and let the wheel pick among the group's favourites.
landing.privacyNote: We only use your Google name, email and avatar to link you to your lists. No ads, no trackers.

propose.title: Propose places
propose.body: Everyone adds the places they dream about: a free photo from Wikimedia Commons, a pin on the map, the budget and the vibe of the trip.

vote.title: Vote together
vote.body: Everyone has 10 points to spread across the places, and the comments are there to talk it over. Points update in real time for the whole group.

spin.title: Spin the wheel
spin.body: Places that received points make it onto the wheel, and more points mean better odds. The draw happens on the server, so nobody can cheat.

plan.title: Plan the itinerary
plan.body: Once the destination is picked, build the trip day by day and reorder the stops by dragging them.

q1.a: Yes. Roamie is free, with no ads and no subscriptions.

q2.q: How do I invite my friends?
q2.a: Every trip has an invite link and an 8-character code. Whoever opens it signs in with Google and joins the group, and you can change the code whenever you like.

q3.a: Everyone has 10 points to spread across the proposed places. Every place with at least one point gets a slice proportional to its points; the draw is random but weighted, and it runs on our servers.

q4.q: Do I need to install an app?
q4.a: No. Roamie works in the browser on phones, tablets and computers, and you can add it to your home screen like an app.

q5.a: Only the name, email and profile picture of your Google account, to link you to your trips. No trackers or profiling (we count site visits anonymously, without cookies), and you can delete your account at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Roamie is private by default: we only collect what's needed to sign you in and collaborate with your group. No data is used for advertising or sold to third parties.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is Ivan Antonino Pace, operator of the Roamie service, reachable at {{contact}}.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: When you sign in with Google we only receive:
items: Email address: used for authentication only, never shown to other members
Google profile name: visible to members of the trips you belong to
Google profile picture: visible to members of the trips you belong to

Content you create: trips, destinations, points, comments, date availability, itinerary stops, useful links, checklist items, ratings of visited places and places added to your passport (visible only to you)

If you turn on notifications: the delivery address your browser assigns to the device, the keys to encrypt messages, the language and the categories you choose; we delete them when you turn notifications off, sign out or delete your account
If you join a trip as a guest, without an account: only the name you choose, visible to the members of your trips. If you later link Google, the items above apply

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: We use this data solely to authenticate you, link you to the trip lists you belong to and show your group who proposed, voted or commented. No data is used for advertising or profiling, or sold to third parties. We also publish an anonymous ranking of the most proposed places ("Trending destinations"): it holds only the place's name and how many times it was proposed or picked, and a place appears only once at least three different groups have proposed it, so it can't be traced back to a trip or a person.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is necessary to provide the service you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, performance of a contract).

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: Roamie uses no profiling cookies and no tracking tools (no Google Analytics, no social pixels). To know how many visits the site gets we use Cloudflare Web Analytics, which counts them in aggregate without cookies or personal identifiers. We only use strictly necessary technical storage, which therefore needs no consent:
items: Sign-in session (localStorage, managed by Supabase Auth) to keep you logged in
Preferred language and wheel sound preference (localStorage)
Cache of place and image searches, to avoid repeated requests to external services (localStorage)
Copy of your trips on this device (IndexedDB), to read them without a connection; deleted when you sign out

sections.title: External services
sections.body: To work, Roamie relies on these providers:
items: Supabase: database and authentication, hosts the service data on servers in the European Union (Ireland)
Vercel: hosting of the website and of the public pages' previews (functions run in the European Union, static content served by a global network)
Google: sign-in with your Google account

OpenStreetMap: maps and place search (Nominatim, plus Photon by komoot for suggestions while you type); their servers receive your IP address and search text when you load the map or search for a place
Wikimedia Commons: destination photos; their servers receive your IP address when images load
Open-Meteo: average climate of destinations; their servers receive the destination's approximate coordinates and your IP address

Browser push services (Google Firebase Cloud Messaging for Chrome and Android, Apple Push Notification service, Mozilla Push Service): they deliver the notifications you turn on; they receive encrypted messages, which they can't read, and the device's delivery address

Cloudflare Web Analytics: anonymous, aggregate statistics on visits and site speed, without cookies; its servers receive the page address, the browser type and your IP address, which is not stored or used to identify you

sections.title: Transfers outside the European Union
sections.body: The service data is stored in the European Union. Some providers (Google, Apple, Mozilla, Cloudflare, Vercel and the delivery networks of the map and image services) may process technical data such as your IP address outside the EU, in particular in the United States: such transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or on the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Data is kept for as long as you keep your account. If you delete it, we erase your profile, the trips you own, your votes and comments; destinations you proposed in other people's trips stay with the group without your name. Guest accounts unused for 60 days are deleted automatically, together with their votes and comments.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct, export (Profile → Download my data) or delete your data and object to its processing. You can delete your account yourself from Profile → Delete account, or by writing to {{contact}}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Roamie you agree to these short, plain-language terms.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: Roamie lets you create shared trip lists, propose destinations, vote and comment on them and plan an itinerary with your group. The service is run by Ivan Antonino Pace, is free and is provided as is.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: You must be at least 14 years old to use Roamie. You sign in with your Google account. You're responsible for what you do with it and for who you invite to your trips through the invite link.

sections.title: Fair use
sections.body: You agree not to use Roamie to:
items: post illegal, offensive or discriminatory content, or content that infringes others' rights
send spam or try to access trips you're not a member of
overload or compromise the service or the external services it uses (maps, place search, images)

sections.title: User content
sections.body: Destinations, comments and itineraries remain yours. Posting them in a trip makes them visible to its members. If the owner makes the trip page public, its name, description, cover, destinations (with photo and score) and itinerary become visible to anyone with the link and may appear in search engines; member names, individual votes and comments stay private, and the page can be made private again at any time. The trip owner can manage members and moderate comments. Wikimedia Commons photos remain subject to their licences, shown on every image.

sections.title: Reporting content
sections.body: If you find content on Roamie that is illegal or infringes your rights, for example on a public trip page, write to {{contact}} with the link and the reason. We review every report, promptly remove illegal content and, where possible, let the person who posted it know.

sections.title: Limited liability
sections.body: Roamie is a planning tool: it doesn't sell travel and doesn't guarantee the accuracy of maps, places or images from external sources. The travel guides give general, indicative information: seasons, prices and conditions change, so always check before you go. To the extent permitted by law, we're not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service or its temporary unavailability.

sections.title: Deleting your account
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from Profile → Delete account: your profile and associated data will be erased, including the trips you own. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update these terms; we'll let you know in the app about significant changes. For any question write to {{contact}}.
